name: Transcript Intent + Urgency Collapse (Calibration)
description: Calibration recipe for the tagging families on top of ASR. Given .txt transcript files (produced by synth_teacher_asr.py or bonfyre-transcribe), Stage 1 applies rule-based intent + urgency classification (zero deps, no model download) to produce 5-class labels: question-high, question-low, command-high, command-low, statement. Stage 2 embeds the same .txt files with MiniLM. Stage 3 collapses to an ONNX topic-map student. The trained head routes transcripts into the correct processing branch (Q&A loop / task dispatch / narrative output) in demo.py and demo_speech_loop.py. Compatible with --conf-exit and --escalate in the SLI adaptive ladder.
